ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Wireless Networking. Prerequisite: CS 438. In this course, we will discuss issues that better define and characterize wireless links and their implications for higher-layer protocol design and optimization. Specifically, we will study the following issues: (T1) control knobs for improving network performance, including power control, physical carrier sense turning, rate control, interference mitigation, channel diversity, and multi-radio and mult-path routing; (T2) modeling and analysis of these control knobs and their effects on the performance; and (T3) cross-layer design and optimization that allow higher-layer protocols to take advanteage of these control knobs. We will also study several representative wireless networks, such as wireless sensor networks and wireless mesh networks.
